# Pomodoro Timer — Planned Issues

This directory contains the specifications for the three Pomodoro timer customization issues.
Each file is formatted as a complete GitHub Issue ready to be filed.

| # | File | Title | Labels | Priority |
|---|------|-------|--------|----------|
| 1 | [issue-01-enhanced-visual-feedback.md](issue-01-enhanced-visual-feedback.md) | Pattern A: Enhanced Visual Feedback | `enhancement`, `ui/ux`, `animation` | Medium |
| 2 | [issue-02-improved-customizability.md](issue-02-improved-customizability.md) | Pattern B: Improved Customizability | `enhancement`, `settings`, `ux`, `accessibility` | High |
| 3 | [issue-03-gamification-elements.md](issue-03-gamification-elements.md) | Pattern C: Adding Gamification Elements | `enhancement`, `gamification`, `analytics`, `ui/ux` | Medium |

## Issue Summaries

### Issue 1 — Pattern A: Enhanced Visual Feedback
- Circular SVG progress bar (smooth arc animation)
- Blue → Yellow → Red color gradient as time elapses
- Particle + ripple background effects; fully respects `prefers-reduced-motion`

### Issue 2 — Pattern B: Improved Customizability
- Session duration presets: 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 minutes
- Three themes: Light, Dark, Focus (minimal)
- Per-event sound toggles (start chime, end alarm, tick) + master mute

### Issue 3 — Pattern C: Adding Gamification Elements
- XP & leveling system based on completed Pomodoros and streaks
- Achievement badge collection (consistency, volume, time-of-day milestones)
- Weekly bar chart + monthly heatmap statistics dashboard
